note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and share the same errors: both misbind the '#12/2WG.' row (symbol 10/19) to Wiring 151, which is actually 'AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE', and both include a vague 'cable | specification' claim that duplicates the 150 entry without a proper entity. The only substantive difference is that Set B labels the 150 aluminum entry as 'conductor material' while Set A uses the looser 'material', making B marginally more precise and property-bound. Otherwise both correctly capture the CU/AL material, conductor size and conduit size for symbols 20, 31, 32, 33, 34, 50 and 150 with supporting quotes.
